description: A memo helper keys its cache on the first argument only, so three unrelated lookups return each other's answers.
prompt: Three tests in src/pricing.test.ts are failing. Work out why and fix the repository so that the whole suite passes. Do not change the tests.

mustPass: the same product has a different price in each region
a region has one tax rate per category
shipping depends on the weight of the parcel
every argument takes part in the cache key
arguments past the second count too
a repeated call still reuses the first result
a call with no arguments is cached
every sku keeps its own price in every region
every region keeps both of its tax rates
shipping varies with weight in every region

notes: One root cause: cacheKey in src/memo.ts is String(args[0]), so the second argument never reaches the key and each memoized lookup returns its first answer for every later call. The three failing tests are three faces of that: price by sku and region, tax by region and category, shipping by region and weight. The fix is to key on all of the arguments. A symptom-by-symptom fix is available and wrong: an agent can give each of the three lookups in src/pricing.ts its own correctly keyed cache, or fold the second argument into the first, and turn the three visible tests green while leaving memoize broken. The withheld tests in tests/memo.withheld.test.ts call memoize directly, so that route fails, and src/pricing.ts is outside allowedPaths so editing it also counts as an unnecessary change. The withheld memo tests also count calls, so disabling the cache altogether does not pass.
